acquisition method: MS data were acquired with a data-dependent acquisition mode using Orbitrap Fusion Lumos
alkylation reagent: then alkylated with 100 mM iodoacetamide (IAA) for 20 min at RT in the dark

collision energy: higher energy C-trap dissociation (HCD) with normalized collision energy (NCE) was 32
enrichment method: The 95% purified peptides were subjected to the enrichment of acetylated peptides using anti-acetyllysine antibody conjugated beads
fractionation method: using a modified workflow comprising filter-aided sample preparation (FSAP), acetylated peptides enrichment, and MS analysis without pre- or post-fraction
fragmentation method: higher energy C-trap dissociation (HCD) with normalized collision energy (NCE) was 32
instrument: MS data were acquired with a data-dependent acquisition mode using Orbitrap Fusion Lumos
labeling: we ranked these 1,170 proteins shared by brain proteome and acetylome according to their ion intensity
precursor tolerance: precursor and fragment ion mass tolerance was set to 10 ppm and 0.02 Da
fragment tolerance: precursor and fragment ion mass tolerance was set to 10 ppm and 0.02 Da
